# Homework Task
Create a map for global gender inequality difference in inequality between 2010 and 2019.

## Forked code for gender inequality difference column
```{r}
# 1. Load required packages
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(countrycode)

# 2. Import global gender inequality data
gii_data <- read_csv(
  "HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv",
  locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
  na = " ", skip=0
)

# 3. Calculate the change in GII
# Negative values indicate reduced inequality
# Positive values indicate increased inequality

gii_data$gii_change <- gii_data$gii_2019 -
  gii_data$gii_2010

# 4. Read world spatial data
world <- st_read("world.geojson")

# 5. Join GII data to world spatial data
# Match countries using ISO3 codes

world_gii <- world %>%
  left_join(
    gii_data,
    by = c("ISO3166.1.Alpha.3" = "iso3")
  )

# 6. Check missing values
nrow(world_gii)
sum(!is.na(world_gii$gii_change))
sum(is.na(world_gii$gii_change))

# 7. Identify unmatched country codes
unmatched <- world %>%
  filter(
    !ISO3166.1.Alpha.3 %in% gii_data$iso3
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(name, ISO3166.1.Alpha.3)

# 8. Create final spatial dataset
world_gii_final <- world_gii %>%
  transmute(
    name = name,
    iso3 = ISO3166.1.Alpha.3,
    gii_2010 = gii_2010,
    gii_2019 = gii_2019,
    gii_change = gii_change
  )

# 9. Export final GeoJSON file
st_write(
  world_gii_final,
  "world_gii_change_2010_2019.geojson",
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)

# 10. Verify exported data
test_map <- st_read(
  "world_gii_change_2010_2019.geojson"
)

nrow(test_map)
names(test_map)
```

## Map

```{r}
library(tmap)
# Set plot mode
tmap_mode("plot")
```
```{r}
map <- tm_shape(world_gii_final) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "gii_change",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      style = "pretty",
      midpoint = 0,
      values = "-brewer.rd_bu",
      value.na = "grey85",
      label.na = "No data"
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "GII change\n(2019 - 2010)"),
    col = "white", lwd = 0.2
  ) +
  tm_title("Change in Gender Inequality Index, 2010–2019") +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE, legend.outside = TRUE)

map
```
```{r}
# Save
tmap_save(map, "prac5_data/world_map.png", width = 10, height = 6, units="in", dpi = 300)
```
